title: ArchMaker Draft (DM-DRAFT, v0)
description: Editable user intent: references to catalog definitions plus SelectionValue entries. Contains manual intent and references only, never derived state. The revision is a monotonic ETag-like token; contentDigest is the semantic digest of the canonical payload once known. Contract state: v0.
$comment: Contract v0 (phase R6, AUD-012). Shared $defs live in common.schema.json. Unknown fields rejected. saveDraft requires expectedRevision.

revision.description: Monotonic revision. Starts at 0 and increments on each successful saveDraft; used as the optimistic-concurrency token.

contentDigest.description: Semantic content digest of the canonical draft payload (ADR-0007). Optional: absent until the draft has been sealed/saved at least once. Serves as the content ETag alongside revision.

catalogRef.description: Catalog the draft is resolved against.

targetRef.description: Export target the draft is intended for.

selections.description: Manual intent selections. Derived selections are not stored here. Each entry carries the value only in value (no duplicated optionId).

presetRefs.description: Presets applied to this draft. Derived selections are recomputed by the resolver.

createdAt.description: Ephemeral creation timestamp; excluded from the canonical hash payload.

updatedAt.description: Ephemeral last-update timestamp; excluded from the canonical hash payload.

saveDraftRequest.description: saveDraft request contract: persists a draft only if the stored revision matches expectedRevision (optimistic concurrency). A mismatch is a conflict error, not a silent overwrite.

draft.description: Draft to persist. Its revision is the new revision to store.

expectedRevision.description: Revision the caller observed; the save is rejected if the stored revision differs.

requestId.description: Optional correlation id for the operation.
